messages:
pagerduty-bot: ⚠️ PagerDuty alert fired for service "prod-inference" (svc_9b7d). Trigger: elevated 5xx and downstream retries from inference-gateway in us-west-2. Incident ID: PD-INC-5999

alex: saw the page. dashboards show a sudden spike of 502/503 around 04:12 UTC. can someone confirm if this is routing or an actual serving failure?

maya: PD payload looks odd - escalation_policy_id points to logging_ops_policy, not inference_oncall. the service in the payload is prod-inference though. this smells like an overlay or sync issue.

chris: digging into infra config: overnight schedule-sync job updated the service->policy mapping during oncall rotation. there was a conflicting overlay patch that got reapplied. will check the vault mapping.

sam: acked via PD mobile (ended up taking it). i thought it was logging flood. sorry if that delayed routing. i can handoff to inference-oncall now.

alex: please do not auto-ack unless you own it. sam, can you add a note and reassign to inference-oncall?

sam: added note: "Misrouted alert. Reassigning to inference-oncall." Reassigning now in PD UI.

pagerduty-bot: Note added to PD-INC-5999 by sam: "Misrouted alert. Reassigning to inference-oncall."

katie: timeline: schedule-sync ran at 04:00 UTC and pushed mappings from the staging overlay. I reverted the immediate PR at 04:05 when we saw noise, but the cron re-ran and reapplied at 04:10. disabling cron now.

alex: priorities: 1) ensure inference-oncall owns it and ACKS 2) mitigate customer impact 3) stop the sync loop and patch overlay mapping

maya: edgar from inference-oncall acknowledged PD-INC-5999 and is looking at the gateway.

edgar: acked. seeing a burst of large batched requests for /v1/stream with model heavy-llama-40b around 04:11-04:13. KV cache thrashing and OOM traces on gpu-18-2.

edgar: immediate mitigation: scale inference pool + attach pod with quantized fallback model (heavy-llama-40b-8bit) and enable early 429 backpressure for non-streaming batch jobs.

edgar: scaling + fallback in progress. applying short circuit-breaker on gateway for 15s on the heavy model path.

alex: good. also throttle the bulk batch endpoints and route traffic away from the troubled AZ if possible.

edgar: traffic shifting done. 5xx rate dropped from peak 11.6% -> 1.1% over 7 minutes. p95 latency improved from 2.2s -> 250ms.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-5999 status: Acknowledged by edgar. Escalation policy now inference-oncall.

chris: root-cause hypothesis: schedule-sync overwrote the escalation mapping stored in vault because the overlay lacked the policy override. the PD payload included the correct service id but wrong policy id.

sam: logging for audit: i left a note about the misroute. we should add an oncall checklist entry for "verify escalation_policy mapping" during handoffs.

maya: created ticket INFRA-3301: "schedule-sync overwrote PD escalation mapping" and assigned to @katie + @infra-ops. attaching terraform diff and cron job logs.

katie: disabling schedule-sync now with: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/oncall-schedule-sync -n infra --replicas=0
```
will add guard in terraform to prevent applying schedule-sync overlays in prod unless explicit flag set. PR incoming.

alex: short customer impact summary for follow-up: ~10 minutes of elevated 5xx for inference streaming endpoints in us-west-2. Affected sessions experienced retries and increased latencies; subset of customers on heavy-llama model saw degraded service. No request data was lost; clients retried where possible.

edgar: metrics: peak 5xx at 04:12-04:14 UTC = 11.6% for /v1/stream. affected request share ~0.02% of traffic but impacted some multi-tenant sessions. p95 latency spike to 2.2s.

maya: drafting postmortem. link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/INFRA-3301-draft

alex: action items: disable schedule-sync until PR (katie), add CI check for PD mapping diffs (chris), create PD replay tests in staging (sam), notify impacted customers and offer post-incident call (maya). ETA for the fix: 3-5 hours for patch and validation.

katie: opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pull/421 - adds protected flag and unit tests. will merge after CI. will re-enable cron only after deploy + smoke tests.

sam: updating runbook to include PD misroute handling and a step to confirm escalation policy -> i'll push a small change to the oncall playbook.

alex: great. edgar, please monitor for 30 minutes before resolving.

edgar: monitoring. no regressions in the last 20 minutes. marking as resolved after 30m clean window.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-5999 status: Resolved by edgar. Resolution summary: scaled pool, applied quantized fallback, enabled gateway backpressure, disabled schedule-sync. Duration: 00:34:12

cs-bot: CS ticket CS-7922 created to notify top customers. Assigned to maya.

alex: thanks all. we should also add a PD routing unit test to our infra CI that replays PD payloads and verifies escalation mapping.

maya: will coordinate customer comms after postmortem review. posting final report in the PM doc when ready.

alex: closing thread. thanks for fast mitigation and for the follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
